fields.description:
## Context / Problem

The GitHub mirror reports 4 critical Dependabot alerts against committed dependency locks:
#65 brotlicffi 1.2.0.1 in `uv.lock` (patched 1.2.1.0), and #66-#68 certifi in
`.github/release-requirements.txt` (2026.6.17) and both
`infra/compose/review-scanners.linux-{amd64,arm64}.requirements.txt` (2026.7.22), patched in
2026.10.18. The same files also carry high alerts that a clean bump clears: oauthlib 3.3.1 in
`uv.lock` (#69, #76; patched 4.0.0) and urllib3 2.7.0 in the release and scanner requirement
files (high #10, #11, #13, #14, #59, #60 and medium #12, #15, #61; patched 2.8.0). Found by
the 2026-11-02 read-only ops sweep (session a85e3cd3).

## Approach

Raise only the affected pins with each file's own generator, so hashes and the rest of the
resolution stay unchanged:

- `uv.lock`: `uv lock --upgrade-package brotlicffi --upgrade-package oauthlib` (uv 0.13.6, the
  `required-version`). Result: brotlicffi 1.2.0.1 -> 1.2.1.0, oauthlib 3.3.1 -> 4.0.1. No
  `pyproject.toml` change: rebar declares neither package directly (brotlicffi comes from
  `httpx[brotli]` on non-CPython only; oauthlib comes from `jira` -> `requests-oauthlib>=3.0.0`
  in the `jira-datacenter` extra), and the existing ranges already admit the fixed versions.
- `.github/release-requirements.txt`: regenerate with the command in its header,
  `uv pip compile --generate-hashes --output-file=.github/release-requirements.txt
  .github/release-requirements.in --upgrade-package certifi --upgrade-package urllib3`.
  Result: certifi 2026.6.17 -> 2026.10.23, urllib3 2.7.0 -> 2.8.0.
- Scanner locks: regenerate both with the documented `docs/security.md` command for the
  unchanged `semgrep==1.145.0` (`--generate-hashes --no-header --python-platform
  {x86_64,aarch64}-manylinux2014 --only-binary=:all:`) plus `--upgrade-package certifi
  --upgrade-package urllib3`. Result: certifi 2026.7.22 -> 2026.10.23, urllib3 2.7.0 -> 2.8.0
  on both platforms. Regenerating the current files without upgrades reproduces them
  byte-for-byte, so the generator matches.

oauthlib 4.x is a major version. Its listed breaking changes are provider-side only (JSONP
removed from the revocation endpoint, grant-type validated before client auth, a new
`validate_device_code` hook for device-flow servers). rebar never imports oauthlib or
requests-oauthlib; the only consumer is `jira` 3.10.5 via `requests-oauthlib` 2.0.0. A scratch
env with jira 3.10.5 + requests-oauthlib 2.0.0 + oauthlib 4.0.1 imports cleanly and signs an
OAuth1 request.

Out of scope (not a clean bump): every mcp alert in the scanner locks (high #1-#6, patched
in 1.23.0/1.27.2/1.28.1; medium #45, #46, #70-#75, patched in 1.30.0) and opentelemetry-api
(#63, #64, medium). semgrep 1.145.0 pins `mcp==1.16.0` and `opentelemetry-api~=1.37.0`, so mcp
can move only by upgrading semgrep itself. The first semgrep that clears the high mcp alerts
is 1.173.0 (`mcp==1.29.0`), a 28-minor-version scanner upgrade that changes the code-review
gate's scanner behavior; even the newest semgrep (1.183.0) pins `mcp==1.29.0`, below the 1.30.0
fix for the medium alerts. That scanner upgrade is a separate decision, not part of this bump.

## Scope

- `uv.lock` — brotlicffi and oauthlib entries only.
- `.github/release-requirements.txt` — certifi and urllib3 entries only.
- `infra/compose/review-scanners.linux-amd64.requirements.txt` — certifi and urllib3 only.
- `infra/compose/review-scanners.linux-arm64.requirements.txt` — certifi and urllib3 only.

## Testing

Dependency bump; no new behavior. Verification: `python scripts/install_review_scanners.py
validate-locks` passes; `make install` then the release-pin, scanner-lock, build-env-lock and
jira/reconciler unit tests (`tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py`,
`tests/unit/test_check_build_env_locked.py`, `tests/unit/test_code_review_ws5.py`,
`tests/scripts/test_dependency_audit.py`, `tests/unit/reconciler/`) pass; `make lint` and
`make typecheck` pass; the Gerrit `Verified` run (including the dependency-audit lane, which
blocks a dependency-map change on any high/critical finding) passes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `uv.lock` locks brotlicffi 1.2.1.0 and oauthlib 4.0.1, with no other package version changed.
- [x] `.github/release-requirements.txt` pins certifi 2026.10.23 and urllib3 2.8.0 with hashes, regenerated by its header command, with no other pin changed.
- [x] Both `infra/compose/review-scanners.linux-*.requirements.txt` files pin certifi 2026.10.23 and urllib3 2.8.0 with hashes, still at `semgrep==1.145.0`, and `validate-locks` passes.
- [x] The change lands on `main` through Gerrit with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
- [x] After the GitHub mirror receives the merge, Dependabot alerts #65-#69 and #76 (critical/high), the oauthlib medium alerts #16 and #17, and the urllib3 alerts #10-#15 and #59-#61 are no longer open (checked read-only via `gh api`).
